svg.aria-label: A Hyprland desktop with a waybar along the bottom. The view zooms into the bar and visits its widgets: a pomodoro timer starts, do not disturb turns on and the song title hides itself, a meeting recorder lights up, dictation types a comment into the editor. The Switchyard board opens from its signal and starts a storefront build, android queues behind it, the Roundhouse lamp turns red and its drawer explains that memory is stalling, its link swaps back to the board where storefront finishes and android starts, the key lights warm the room, and the clock switches time zones.

g.text: // back off and retry, give up after five tries
everything is stalling on memory (22% of the last 10 s)
Switchyard is holding android: Roundhouse says everything is…
25 minutes of focus, then a break
hides itself too, so songs stay off screen shares
voxtype types it where the cursor is
the board behind the signal: builds, launches, deploys
storefront builds on the main line
one heavy build at a time, so android queues
memory is stalling: the lamp turns red and android is held
its Switchyard link opens the board from the same lamp
storefront is done, the lamp calms down, android starts
both Elgato lights in one click
